products.title: Sculpted: The 12-Week Aesthetic Blueprint
products.tagline: A 12-week hypertrophy programme for a balanced, proportioned physique — not just a bigger one.
products.description: A 12-week hypertrophy programme for intermediate and advanced lifters, built around proportion and symmetry rather than raw size. Three phases (Foundation, Build, Sculpt) each with their own exercise selection, sets, reps, RIR and tempo planned week by week, plus a nutrition chapter, recovery guidance, an exercise swap guide and a progress tracker.
highlights: 3 phases across 12 weeks: Foundation, Build, Sculpt
Every session planned — sets, reps, RIR, rest and tempo
Nutrition chapter for an aesthetic physique

products.title: Short and Sharp: 21 Days of Intervals for Fat Loss
products.cover_sub: 21 Days of Intervals for Fat Loss
products.tagline: Interval sessions you can finish inside half an hour.
products.description: Twenty-one days of high-intensity interval training, each session designed to be done in under thirty minutes. Covers work-to-rest structures, scaling for your current fitness, and how to recover between sessions.

products.title: Ground Up: Calisthenics from Press-Ups to Muscle-Ups
products.tagline: Real strength with no equipment and no gym membership.
products.description: A progression from press-ups and rows through to pull-ups, dips and muscle-ups, using bodyweight and a bar. Every movement has a regression to start from and a clear standard to hit before moving on.

products.title: Your First Online Income: From Idea to Getting Paid
products.tagline: Pick something to sell, find the people who want it, get paid.
products.description: A step-by-step route from having nothing to sell to receiving your first payments: choosing something you can actually deliver, pricing it honestly, finding the first buyers, and reinvesting what comes back.

products.title: The Sales Conversation: Discovery, Objections and Price
products.tagline: Handle a high-value call without sounding like a salesman.
products.description: How high-value sales calls are actually run: opening properly, asking questions that surface the real problem, handling objections without pressure, presenting price with confidence, and following up without pestering.

products.title: The One-Person Business: Offers, Systems and What to Leave Out
products.cover_sub: Offers, Systems and What to Leave Out
products.tagline: Build a business that runs properly without hiring anyone.
products.description: The structure of a business one person can run well: designing an offer, pricing it, building systems that remove repeat work, and deciding what to deliberately not do.

products.title: Answer Every Call: Building an AI Phone Receptionist
products.tagline: A voice agent that answers, captures the enquiry and texts back.
products.description: A complete build guide for an AI phone receptionist, written from a system in daily use with small businesses. Covers designing the call flow, writing prompts that hold up against real callers, connecting the voice layer to a phone number, capturing and routing the enquiry, sending the follow-up text, handing over to a human, and what it costs to run per call. The last third is about failure: what breaks, how to hear about it before your customer does, and how to test against messy calls rather than tidy ones.
highlights: Full call flow design, from greeting to qualified enquiry to text follow-up
Prompt patterns that survive interruptions, accents, background noise and rambling callers
Handover rules: when the agent should stop talking and fetch a human
Failure handling, monitoring and per-call cost, so it doesn't break silently

products.title: Selling AI Services: What to Charge and How to Find Clients
products.cover_sub: What to Charge and How to Find Clients
products.tagline: AI services one person can realistically sell, priced and positioned.
products.description: A set of AI-assisted services a single operator can sell to small businesses, with the tools each one needs, what to charge, and how to land the first clients.

products.title: The Automated Back Office: Workflows for Enquiries, Bookings and Follow-Up
products.cover_sub: Workflows for Enquiries, Bookings and Follow-Up
products.tagline: Take the repetitive admin out of your week, one workflow at a time.
products.description: A practical programme for automating the admin behind a one-person operation: deciding what is actually worth automating, mapping a process properly before you build it, and wiring enquiries, quotes, bookings, follow-ups and records between the tools you already pay for. Includes the parts most guides skip: where to keep a human in the loop, how to handle errors and retries, what to log, and how to notice when a workflow has quietly stopped running.
highlights: A method for mapping a process before you automate it, so you don't automate a mess
Working patterns for enquiry capture, quotes, bookings, reminders and follow-up
Human-in-the-loop checkpoints: what to approve, what to let run unattended
Error handling, retries, logging and alerts for workflows that fail quietly

products.title: Keeping Your Word: Character, Responsibility and How You Treat People
products.cover_sub: Character, Responsibility and How You Treat People
products.tagline: The standards and routines that make someone worth relying on.
products.description: The standards, routines and decisions that make someone reliable: doing what you said you would, taking responsibility when it costs you, handling money and conflict properly, and how you treat the people around you.

products.title: Attention: 30 Days to a Less Distracted Mind
products.cover_sub: 30 Days to a Less Distracted Mind
products.tagline: Rebuild the ability to concentrate for more than ten minutes.
products.description: A thirty-day reset for a scattered mind: auditing what you consume, cutting compulsive phone and feed use, and rebuilding the ability to work on one thing for a long stretch.

products.title: Consistency: Habits That Survive a Bad Week
products.cover_sub: Habits That Survive a Bad Week
products.tagline: Habit design that holds up when motivation runs out.
products.description: Habit design for real life: environment over willpower, identity-based change, and a proper plan for getting back on track after you break a streak.

products.title: Sleep: Why It Slips and How to Get It Back
products.cover_sub: Why It Slips and How to Get It Back
products.tagline: The levers that genuinely move your sleep, and the ones that don't.
products.description: A practical guide to sleeping properly again. Light, temperature, caffeine and alcohol timing, and a wind-down that survives a real evening rather than an ideal one. Covers what to do when you wake at three in the morning, working around shifts and early starts, and how much of the popular advice actually holds up. Also where the line is between a habit worth fixing yourself and a problem worth taking to a doctor.
highlights: Light, temperature and caffeine timing - the levers with the strongest evidence behind them
A wind-down built for a normal evening, not a spa routine you will abandon
What to do at three in the morning, and why lying there trying harder makes it worse
Shift work, early starts, and when poor sleep is medical rather than behavioural

products.title: What to Eat: Protein, Calories and Cutting Through the Noise
products.cover_sub: Protein, Calories and Cutting Through the Noise
products.tagline: Work out what goes on the plate, and stop relitigating it every week.
products.description: A practical guide to everyday eating. Setting protein and calorie targets from your own numbers rather than a generic chart, building a small set of meals you are happy to repeat, shopping and cooking without it swallowing your week, and handling restaurants, drinking and the stretches where it all falls apart. Also runs the popular approaches - low carb, fasting, high protein - against what the evidence actually supports, and says plainly where it is still unsettled.
highlights: Setting protein and calorie targets from your own numbers, not a generic chart
A small set of repeatable meals, so eating well stops depending on willpower
Eating out, drinking, holidays, and the weeks it all falls apart
What the evidence supports across low carb, fasting and high protein

products.title: The Gut Reset: A 90-Day Plan for Digestion and the Microbiome
products.cover_sub: A 90-Day Plan for Digestion and the Microbiome
products.tagline: Ninety days to work out what your gut actually tolerates.
products.description: A structured ninety-day elimination and reintroduction plan to identify what you tolerate, alongside fibre laddering, fermented foods and a simple way to track symptoms.
